applies_to: Belimo ..M(C)24A-MOD, ..R24A-MOD, ..V(K)24A-MOD, ..F24A-MOD, ..RF24A-MOD and ..H24A-MOD air/water actuators, per Modbus interface description edition 2026-05 / V3.08.
summary: Belimo's standard damper and valve actuators in the -MOD version speak Modbus RTU on RS-485 directly. The map is small and flat: a position setpoint, an override, position feedback and an optional sensor input in registers 1-13, then identity, fault flags, Min/Max limits, the bus watchdog and the setpoint source from register 100 up. Everything is a 16-bit unsigned value.

addressing.note: Belimo prints each register twice: 'No.' counts from 1 and 'Address' from 0, and the documented value here is the No. column. Register No. 1 (setpoint) is wire address 0. Every value sits in one flat table, so holding-register reads (FC 3) and writes (FC 6/16) reach everything; FC 4 input-register reads of the same addresses also work.

source.title: Modbus Interface Description - Air/water actuators (General actuators for air and water)
source.pages: General notes pp. 3-4; register overview p. 5; register descriptions pp. 6-8

notes: Belimo states that all register values are unsigned 16-bit integers; a register that does not apply to the device or its settings reads 65535.

Sensor 1 value (No. 9) changes meaning with Sensor 1 type (No. 108): mV for Active, ohms for the passive types, 0/1 for Switch (scale 1), and 0.1 °C or 0.1 °F for the PT1000/NI1000/NTC10K2 types. It is listed raw (scale 1); multiply by 0.1 yourself for the temperature types.
Writable registers above No. 100 are stored in non-volatile memory; Belimo says not to write them on a regular basis.
No. 190/191 exist only on electronic fail-safe actuators; other types return 65535.
Registers 7, 8, 10-12 and 111-118 are unused in this actuator range and are not listed.
Read Discrete Inputs (FC 2) can also read the bits of No. 105: start bit address = 104 x 16 = 1664.

registers.name: Setpoint
registers.description: Position setpoint 0-100 %, scaled between Min (No. 106) and Max (No. 107).

registers.name: Override control
registers.description: Forces a fixed position instead of the setpoint.

registers.name: Command
registers.description: Starts a service function; reads back 0 once accepted. 4 clears No. 105.

registers.name: Absolute position
registers.description: Degrees for rotary actuators, mm for linear actuators.

registers.name: Sensor 1 value
registers.description: Raw reading of sensor input 1; meaning and scale follow No. 108 (see notes).

registers.name: Analog setpoint
registers.description: Setpoint seen on the 0-10 V input when Setpoint source = Analog.

registers.name: Bus termination
registers.description: Shows whether the built-in 120 ohm terminator is on (set with the tool).

registers.name: Series number 1st part
registers.description: First block of the serial number on the housing label.

registers.name: Series number 2nd part
registers.description: Second block of the serial number.

registers.name: Series number 4th part
registers.description: Fourth block of the serial number (the third is not exposed).

registers.name: Firmware version
registers.description: Bus module firmware; 302 means version 3.02.

registers.name: Malfunction and service information
registers.description: Bit-coded fault and status flags; clear with Command = 4.

bits.1: Mechanical travel increased (moved outside adapted range)

registers.name: Min
registers.description: Lower position limit; must stay at least 20 % below Max. Default 0.

registers.name: Max
registers.description: Upper position limit; must stay at least 20 % above Min. Default 100 %.

registers.name: Sensor 1 type
registers.description: What is wired to sensor input 1; restart may be needed after a change.

registers.name: Bus fail position
registers.description: Where the actuator goes when the bus watchdog expires.

registers.name: Timeout for bus watchdog
registers.description: 0 disables; defaults to 120 s once a bus fail position is set.

registers.name: Setpoint source
registers.description: Bus = No. 1 drives the actuator; Analog = 0-10 V on wire 3. Default Bus.

registers.name: Fail-safe bridging time
registers.description: Delay before the fail-safe move after power loss (electronic fail-safe types only).

registers.name: Fail-safe position
registers.description: Position taken on power loss (electronic fail-safe types; knob on 'Tool').

integration.summary: Wire to the RS-485 terminals, set address and frame with the Belimo Assistant app (or the Address button quick-addressing), then write the position in 0.01 % to register 1 (wire address 0) and poll registers 5 and 105. Leave Setpoint source (No. 119) at Bus, its default.
integration.enable: Modbus is active out of the box on -MOD actuators; Setpoint source (No. 119) defaults to Bus. Address (1-247), baud rate and frame are set with the Belimo Assistant 2 app or tool, and the address can also be set with the Address and Adaption buttons (see the product datasheet).
integration.watchdog: Not monitored by default. Set Bus fail position (No. 109) and Timeout for bus watchdog (No. 110, 0-3600 s; 0 = off, 120 s default once a fail position is set). If neither No. 1 nor No. 2 is written within the timeout, the actuator goes to the fail position and bit 10 of No. 105 is set. In hybrid mode (Setpoint source = Analog) bus monitoring is not active.
quirks: The No. column is 1-based; subtract 1 for the wire address (setpoint = address 0).
Min and Max must stay at least 20 % apart (Min <= Max - 20 %, Max >= Min + 20 %).
Registers that a device or its settings don't support read 65535.
setup: Factory frame is 38400 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits (1-8-N-2), address 1.
Up to 32 nodes per segment without a repeater; terminate the bus ends with 120 ohm.
gotchas: Don't write the persistent registers (No. 101 and up) on every poll cycle - they live in non-volatile memory.
Fast open / Fast close overrides add mechanical wear; Belimo suggests keeping them for events like frost protection.
